items.title: 22.2 Key statistical measures and their calculation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Statistics mein kuch bunyadi paimane (key measures) samajhna aur nikalna data ka khulasa karne aur us ka matlab samajhne ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh paimane batate hain ke data ka markaz kahan hai (central tendency), data kitna badalta hai (variability) aur kaise phaila hua hai (distribution); is se patterns pehchan kar sahih faisle kiye jate hain. Mean ausat (average) qeemat batata hai, median beech wala nuqta, aur mode woh qeemat jo data mein sab se zyada baar aati hai. Standard deviation aur range data ka phailao (spread) naapte hain, jabke percentiles data ko khaas hisson (intervals) mein baant kar mazeed gehra analysis karne dete hain.

Pehle teen (mean, median, mode) batate hain ke data ka 'beech' kahan hai. Agle do (standard deviation, range) batate hain ke qeematein us beech se kitni door tak phaili hain. Percentile batata hai ke koi qeemat data mein kis darje par hai.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaun se paimane data ka markaz (central tendency) aur kaun se phailao (spread) batate hain: mean, range, mode, standard deviation, median?
blocks.explanation: Markaz: mean, median aur mode. Phailao: standard deviation aur range.

items: Central tendency: mean (ausat), median (beech wali qeemat), mode (sab se zyada aane wali qeemat).
Spread: standard deviation aur range; percentiles data ko hisson mein baant'te hain.
